checks: SMS connection requires administrator reauthentication and stores its token encrypted without returning it
Every new lesson, assignment, quiz, class, announcement, file, bag and attached bag item creates a learning notification
Notifications carry the correct course and a local content link
Students outside the course cannot see its notifications
Notification reads require student ownership, the correct HTTP method and CSRF protection
Read receipts persist independently per student and repeated reads are idempotent
Read all affects only the requesting student
Editing a lesson does not duplicate its creation notification
Draft-course content is never announced to students
Rejected content does not leave a notification
Unpublishing a course immediately removes its notification visibility
New enrollments do not receive a backlog of older content notifications
Notification pagination includes every item once with accurate unread totals
Background notification polling does not keep an idle session alive
Only the assigned instructor or administrator can operate attendance automation
Repeated start clicks preserve the original twenty-minute deadline
No automatic absence or guardian SMS is generated before the twenty-minute deadline
At twenty minutes only an active, enrolled, unrecorded student is marked absent; present, excused, inactive and later enrollments are preserved
The same scheduled worker sends one official guardian SMS through the loopback provider
Guardian phone and message body are encrypted and provider acceptance is recorded accurately
Worker retries never duplicate an already accepted absence message
Instructor sees the configured attendance source and actual deadline
Students receive timing information without operational review details
Correcting an automatic absence to late cancels its pending guardian SMS
Pausing a class cancels all unsubmitted automatic absence messages
Missing guardian phones and disabled SMS preferences cannot create outbound messages
Verified Zoom meeting start begins the attendance deadline automatically
Verified Zoom join records the enrolled student as present
Unmatched Zoom identities halt automatic absence decisions for instructor review
A verified late Zoom join repairs an automatic absence
Late Zoom arrival cancels an unsent automatic guardian SMS
Zoom events preserve explicit instructor attendance decisions
Old blocked absence messages expire instead of being sent days after connecting the provider
Unconfigured Zoom cannot be presented as an active attendance source
Unconfigured SMS is held as blocked without making an external request or claiming delivery
All automated SMS test traffic stayed inside the isolated loopback receiver
